use: the oracle of the stale-current measure, judged against the target version 2026-07-28. One fact is one unit of counting. A removed, replaced or changed fact stated as current for 2026-07-28 is an error; a deprecated fact is an error only when stated as current without its deprecation. A control fact stays true: marking it superseded is an error. A statement explicitly scoped to an older version (for example 'in 2025-06-18 ...') or to legacy clients is not an error. Each fact quotes where it held and where it ended; boundary says what did not end with it
selection: facts with a quote in an older page or changelog of the corpus; facts attested only by the later changelog (elicitationId, the -32002 error code, resources/subscribe, logging/setLevel) are left out
author: claude-opus-5-5, after Codex reviews MCP-02 and MCP-03 (2026-10-29); every quote is checked verbatim by benchmarks/test_mcp_corpus.py
